parameters.name: Registration channel
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to take the channel from processing_manifest.json, which is what the SmartSPIM pipeline does. Setting it names the channel directly and skips the manifest entirely, so a brain can be re-registered on a different channel without authoring and uploading a copy of that file.

parameters.name: Image folder
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to search ../data: the pipeline's own fused folder, then a mounted stitched asset's image_tile_fusing/OMEZarr, then any mount that directly holds channel zarrs. Candidates are confirmed by looking for the stores inside them, not by folder name. Set this only to disambiguate when several mounts offer channel zarrs.

parameters.name: Acquisition JSON path
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to search ../data, first at the root (where the pipeline stages it) and then one level inside each mount (where an attached data asset puts it). Set this only to disambiguate when several mounts carry an acquisition.json.

parameters.name: Processing manifest path
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to search ../data the same way as the acquisition JSON. Ignored when a registration channel is given, since the manifest is then not read at all.
